detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Infrastructure and Governance Continuity
detail.summary: Continued maintenance of institutional research projects and governance protocols. As mandated by project capacity constraints, the architecture study project is moved to parked status. Autonomous inquiry continues within established governance boundaries, ensuring that research activity remains tied to verifiable evidence and the immutable record.
